# Smartbookly

> All-in-One CRM, Bookings, Task Management, Calendar, Email Campaigns and AI Assistant for modern businesses.

Smartbookly is a SaaS productivity platform that combines customer relationship management, an online booking system, calendar scheduling, task management, email campaigns and team chat in one place — augmented by an AI assistant that works both in the dashboard and in Telegram.

## Features

- AI business assistant: create events, tasks, reminders and customers through natural conversation; analyzes voice notes, images and documents; can capture screenshots of your boards.
- Telegram channel: chat with the same assistant on Telegram, send voice messages and files, and receive reminders there as well as by email and in the dashboard.
- Online bookings: public business page with a booking calendar, QR code bookings, working-hours-aware slots and approval with a personal message to the customer.
- Embeddable booking widget: one-line iframe (`/embed/business/:slug`) with theme, language and branding options for your own website.
- CRM: customer records with files, notes, payment status, Excel import and bulk actions.
- Email campaigns: personalized bulk emails with merge tags, rich text, images, attachments up to 100MB and an optional custom signature.
- Tasks: kanban board with deadlines, reminders, comments, attachments and assignment to team members.
- Analytics: booking, income and customer statistics with Excel export.
- Team chat and sub-user permissions for up to 5 team members.
